annual_training: All mature endpoints strictly before first target date in each year; expanding2015+ history. Development2020–2023; earlier trainable decisions get post-selection contextual evaluation. Earliest dates without mature labels explicitly unavailable.
selection: Must pass original V17 strict champion gates AND V17-relative aggregate return>=0, drawdown>=-0.005, achievement>=-0.005, shortfall<=0.0025, NDCG>=0; every profile return>=-0.025 and drawdown>=-0.01; utility gain>=0.002; improvement utility in >=3 of4 calendar years. Utility uses .45NDCG+.20achievement-.25shortfall+.10drawdown+.10medianXIRR; meanXIRR zero. Rank eligible by utility then lower beta.
round2: Exactly top3 round1 families by development utility, independent of eligibility; equal pairs and triple, beta0.05/0.10. Additional seed-averagedV17, component-agreement confidence, and short-history confidence controls. Stop after this registered space and robustness; no threshold chasing.
stopping: 10 trained families,20 single-model strengths,8 ensemble combinations,6 baseline/confidence controls; maximum34 selection configurations. Finalist robustness alternate seed and per-date refit; if no defensible eligible finalist survives, V17 remains best.
exposed_current_policy: No2024–2025 outcome or current inference until final selection lock; previous exposure acknowledged. No identity, current fundamentals/industry, or source shortcuts.
point_in_time_limit: Price-derived features and maturity-purged labels; fixed-universe survivorship and source-revision limits remain.
fundamentals_peers: Only if dated source available. Existing panels have no valid dated fundamentals/industry history; current-only diagnostic layer retained.
neural: Two-expert MLP32/16, soft gate over user/regime inputs; pairwise utility + pointwise utility;8 epochs,600 pairs/query; seed fixed.
